**Kind:** unpursued implication. **Location:** cote 16, scan 49, parenthetical “category of motives which is semi-simple”.

Jannsen (1992, Theorem 1) proves, for characteristic-zero coefficient fields and adequate equivalence relations, that the category of pure motives is semisimple abelian precisely when the equivalence relation is numerical.
